description: Per-keyword PLA ad request / response volume and response rate on search pages for a marketplace over a period, from the timezone-aware search-query request report (dates are converted to the marketplace timezone). One row per keyword. Replaces the three keyword-request reports: use requests + responses + response_rate for keyword-level RR, requests + responses for the Pareto / zero-vs-partial-response buckets, and requests + days_with_requests to judge whether a keyword has enough demand to warrant a campaign. Filter keyword NOT IN ('') to drop requests that carried no search query; use a metrics filter on requests to apply a minimum-volume threshold.

keyword.description: The normalized search query (keyword) users typed, lower-cased and stripped of bracket/quote characters.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.request ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Total ad requests received for this keyword on search pages over the period.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.response ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Total ad responses (non-empty fills) served for this keyword on search pages over the period.

response_rate.selector: SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.response ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.request ELSE 0 END), 0), 0))
response_rate.description: Response rate for this keyword (responses * 100 / requests) on search pages over the period.

days_with_requests.selector: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') END)
days_with_requests.description: Number of distinct days (in the marketplace timezone) on which this keyword received at least one request.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_search_query_request_report` AS r JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date_hour_utc >= DATETIME_SUB(DATETIME '__START_DATE_1__', INTERVAL 2 DAY) AND r.date_hour_utc < DATETIME_ADD(DATETIME '__END_DATE_1__', INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
